title: Launch HN: Adam (YC W25) – Open-Source AI CAD
summary: Adam is building AI agents for mechanical CAD software, advocating for a 'CAD as code' paradigm where text prompts generate CAD models. They've released CADAM, an open-source Text-to-CAD platform built with React and Supabase, targeting democratization of mechanical design through AI.
problem_solved: Makes mechanical CAD design accessible through natural language instead of requiring mastery of complex traditional CAD software
why_valuable: Enables rapid CAD prototyping by converting text descriptions directly into 3D models, similar to how AI coding assistants transform requirements into functional code
